measures.id: Pickaway County Park District Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal and Increase)
measures.title: Pickaway County Park District tax levy (renewal of 0.5 mill and increase of 0.25 mill)
measures.summary: Renews a 0.5-mill tax and adds 0.25 mill for the Pickaway County Park District, to maintain existing facilities, expand and develop new trails and parks, and help cities, villages and townships in the county improve their parks and trails. The county auditor estimates the 0.75-mill total will collect $1,466,613 a year, or $20 for each $100,000 of market value, for 10 years starting in 2027, first due in 2028.
measures.yesMeans: The park district levy would be renewed and increased to 0.75 mill for 10 years.
measures.noMeans: The park district levy would not be renewed or increased.
